entities.name: Columbus Sighting and Early European Contact
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Columbus sighted Saint Vincent on January 22, 1498 (Saint Vincent's Day). However, the fierce Kalinago resistance prevented any European settlement. The island was declared a neutral Carib territory by agreement between France and Britain in 1660.
